title: Add native fault coverage for combined Windows owned-job cleanup
outcome: Deterministic native tests cover exceptional StopAndWaitForCleanup orchestration and its published unresolved result.
acceptance: Exercise partial capture/query/wait failure through combined cleanup and Run publication, verifying exact-job termination still occurs and cleanup remains unresolved/nonzero.
Verify retained member handles close on all exceptional paths and an admission-count change is reported without weakening existing held/released or unrelated-process assertions.
